D: A square-jawed detective takes on Big Boy Caprice's gangsters.
P: Serve the mains when Big Boy holds court at the Club Ritz.
S: Breathless Mahoney sings at the Club Ritz
Devilled eggs (yolks whipped with mayo and Dijon) topped with salmon roe, and blanched asparagus spears wrapped in prosciutto.
Tracy's trench coat in pastry form
Gougères: choux pastry (water, butter, flour, eggs) with gruyère and a pinch of turmeric for yellow, piped and baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
the Kid's diner on the corner
Quick pickles: cucumber and green tomato in hot brine of vinegar, water, sugar, salt, dill seed and garlic, chilled overnight, served cold in a jar.
M: Beef chuck browned and braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot and stock, potatoes for the last hour.
eaten at the head of the table, like a boss
Pork and beef meatballs with soaked bread, egg and parmesan, browned, simmered an hour in San Marzano tomato sauce with basil, tossed with spaghetti, more parmesan.
W: Blind-baked shortcrust, lemon curd filling (lemon juice, zest, sugar, yolks, cornflour, butter), Italian meringue piled high and torched.
K: Gin and dry vermouth stirred over ice for 30 seconds, strained into a chilled glass, lemon twist.

s.note: Breathless Mahoney sings at the Club Ritz
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo and 1 tsp Dijon, pipe back and top with salmon roe. Blanch a bunch of asparagus and wrap each spear in half a slice of prosciutto.

s.note: Tracy's trench coat in pastry form
s.how: Bring 125ml water and 50g butter to the boil, beat in 75g flour and cook a minute. Cool slightly, beat in 2 eggs, then 80g grated gruyère and a pinch of turmeric. Pipe small mounds and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

m.note: eaten at the head of the table, like a boss
m.how: Mix 600g pork and beef mince with 2 slices bread soaked in milk, 1 egg and 40g parmesan. Roll into balls and brown. Simmer an hour in 2 tins San Marzano tomatoes with basil. Toss with 500g spaghetti and more parmesan.

w.how: Blind-bake a tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust. Cook the juice and zest of 3 lemons, 150g sugar, 3 tbsp cornflour and 250ml water until thick, then beat in 3 yolks and 50g butter. Fill, top with 3 whites whipped with 150g sugar and torch.

d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth over plenty of ice for 30 seconds. Strain into a chilled martini glass and twist a strip of lemon peel over the top. Makes four.
